resources.string: In N-Zik on your phone, open Manage server, start pairing, then tap Scan and point the camera at this code.
Enter a name of 1 to 64 characters.
The code renews itself every 2 minutes.
Type the address and code shown on your phone
Your phone could not reach this PC. Windows Firewall, or a network set to Public? Allow N-Zik Desktop Compagnon on private networks, or pair manually below.
No local network address was found on this PC, so no QR code can be shown. Pair manually below.
On your phone, Manage server shows the IP address, the port and a 6-character code.
Enter an IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.14.
The code has 6 characters, for example ABC-DEF.
Invalid or expired code. Check the code on your phone and try again.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d s.
Phone version incompatible (contract %1$s). Update N-Zik Desktop Compagnon or N-Zik.
The phone could not be reached. Check that its server is running and that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
The pairing could not be saved in the Windows Credential Manager.
The pairing listener could not be opened. Pair manually below.
This PC appears as %1$s on the phone.
Another PC (%1$s) is connected to the phone. Disconnect it from the phone, then retry.
The phone answered with an error (HTTP %1$d, %2$s).
Removes the pairing from this PC
%1$s did not answer at %2$s. Its server may be stopped, or its IP address may have changed. The pairing is kept.
Keep the pairing, change the phone’s IP address only
This PC was removed from the phone’s paired devices. Pair it again to keep using it.
